title: Attacker url observed in the wild: http://play.nopixel-rp.ir/ (OffSeq Mirage)
description: The URL http://play.nopixel-rp.ir/ was observed twice in attacker activity on 2026-10-24 by OffSeq Mirage honeypot sensors. It is associated with the MITRE ATT&CK technique T1105 (Ingress Tool Transfer), indicating its use in attacker payloads such as tool downloads, callbacks, or exploitation targets. The attacker infrastructure was identified as originating from Great Britain. This URL serves as an indicator of compromise (IOC) and should be blocked and monitored in network defenses.
